property_summary: For any uint16 feeRate input, calling initialize(...) on a fresh C instance always succeeds (does not revert) and sets initialized==true for all feeRate < = 5000 in the reference; the mutant that changes the check to >=5000 will revert for feeRate == 5000, leaving initialized==false.
change_summary: Change the fee rate upper bound check from > 5000 to >= 5000 so initialize reverts for feeRate == 5000 (previously allowed), altering initialized after call.
